title_working: Trait representation and phylogenetic sampling jointly determine whether evolutionary memory is measurable
question: Given the same known true phylogenetic memory signal (rho=0.15), which properties of a real family x trait sampling design determine whether that signal can be recovered?

response_family.primary: system_temporal_pass under the already-frozen dual S3 + prune-only recovery gate
secondary: S3 median absolute recovery error among calibrated systems
S3 directional recovery among calibrated systems
prune-only median absolute recovery error among systems reaching that axis
maximum attainable S3 pilot median effect across the frozen lambda grid for calibration-HOLD systems

prohibited: family identity as a causal predictor
trait identity as a causal predictor

primary_model.standardization: z-score continuous predictors over all 722 systems before fitting
primary_model.cluster_robust_uncertainty: two-way cluster bootstrap by family and trait_name, 2000 replicates, seed 20261004
primary_quantities: odds ratio for nominal categorical vs continuous at mean sample size
odds ratio per 1 SD log species count
odds ratio per 1 SD prune fraction

continuous_only_model.purpose: Separate sample-size/geometry effects from the representation effect after categorical systems are removed.

descriptive_thresholds.rule: Estimate, from the fitted model only, the n_species giving predicted pass probability 0.5 for continuous and categorical systems at mean prune fraction. This is descriptive and not an admission threshold.

causal_nonclaim: The analysis identifies measurement-design correlates of recoverability, not biological causes of trait conservatism.
biological_interpretation: If representation remains dominant after sample size and native-tip fraction adjustment, comparative studies cannot assume that equal underlying evolutionary memory is equally detectable across continuous and categorical traits. If sample size dominates within continuous traits, family-level comparative signal is limited by phylogenetic sampling geometry even when the underlying effect is held constant.
